rv.q: A Beautiful Noise may not have delivered all the theatrical excitement I was hoping for, but I had a good time, especially during the second act.
For fans of Neil Diamond, A Beautiful Noise offers an entertaining evening filled with his greatest songwriting hits but does not succeed to deliver on the real storytelling of his life.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this Diamond jukebox musical — fans may enjoy the nostalgia, but weak storytelling keeps it from shining. The beloved songs are the highlight; the narrative framework gets mixed marks.
